US inmate critical after botched lethal injection execution

A female inmate in Tennessee is in critical condition following a lethal injection execution that was reportedly botched. The state has initiated a review of its lethal injection process in light of the incident. Details regarding the specific issues during the execution have not been fully disclosed, but the event has led to scrutiny of the methods used.
